artifacts.title: NVIDIA FY2024-FY2026 Revenue Summary and Trend
artifacts.program:
f2024 = 60922
f2025 = 130497
f2026 = 215938
rev_labels = ["FY2024", "FY2025", "FY2026"]
rev_values = [f2024 / 1000, f2025 / 1000, f2026 / 1000]  # billions
rev_growth_2025 = @Round((f2025 - f2024) / f2024 * 100, 1)
rev_growth_2026 = @Round((f2026 - f2025) / f2025 * 100, 1)
growth_labels = ["FY2025 YoY", "FY2026 YoY"]
growth_values = [rev_growth_2025, rev_growth_2026]

header = CardHeader("NVIDIA Revenue Comparison FY2024 to FY2026", "From official NVIDIA annual reports for fiscal years 2025 and 2026")

revenue_table = Table([
  Col("Fiscal Year", ["FY2024", "FY2025", "FY2026"]),
  Col("Revenue (USD billions)", ["$60.9B (p. 130, 2025 report)", "$130.5B (p. 130, 2025 report)", "$215.9B (p. 37, 2026 report)"])
])

revenue_chart = LineChart(
  rev_labels,
  [Series("Revenue (USD billions)", rev_values)],
  "linear",
  "Fiscal Year",
  "Revenue (USD billions)",
  240
)
growth_chart = BarChart(
  growth_labels,
  [Series("Growth Rate (%)", growth_values)],
  "grouped",
  "Fiscal Year",
  "% Change",
  160
)

growth_note = Callout(
  "info",
  "Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth",
  "FY2025 revenue increased by " + rev_growth_2025 + "% compared to FY2024. FY2026 revenue increased by " + rev_growth_2026 + "% compared to FY2025."
)

root = Card([
  header,
  revenue_table,
  revenue_chart,
  growth_chart,
  growth_note
], [
  {"title": "\u201CRevenue for fiscal year 2025 was $130.5 billion, up 114% from a year ago.\u201D", "sourceName": "NVIDIA 2025 Annual Report · Page 130", "url": "https://s201.q4cdn.com/141608511/files/doc_financials/2025/annual/NVIDIA-2025-Annual-Report.pdf#page=130"},
  {"title": "\u201CRevenue for fiscal year 2026 was $215.9 billion, up 65% from a year ago.\u201D", "sourceName": "NVIDIA 10-K 2026 · Page 37", "url": "https://investor.nvidia.com/files/doc_financials/2026/q4/10K-NVDA.pdf#page=37"}
])
